name: Hermes

source.query: SELECT model, tool_call_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, started_at FROM sessions ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 5

note: Hermes documents one project context file per session, first match wins, in this order: .hermes.md or HERMES.md, AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules. The probe returns the first path that matches, so the declared order is that chain and the capability names the file Hermes actually loaded. SOUL.md is the exception: the documentation says it is loaded from HERMES_HOME only and never from the working directory, so it is inherited rather than project. Memories and skills are both under ~/.hermes. Not declared: the walk to the git root and the progressive discovery of subdirectory files as the agent reads them, neither of which a probe at the session's working directory can see; and HERMES_HOME relocates every inherited path; both halves follow it as of 2026-09-26 through source.relocate — the session store and the inherited capability paths. HERMES_HOME is declared as of 2026-09-26 for the session store; the inherited capability paths under the same root are still not relocated.
